commands.sdbf.tree_realm.unsafe: No safe arrival position was found.
text.sdbf.book_page.1: MR-C research group. Collect Menril resin at different heights and keep blank variable cards separate from the samples.
text.sdbf.book_page.2: Resin crystallizes faster in the canopy. The research room is below an ordinary house. Use the corner maintenance hatch to reach it.
text.sdbf.book_page.3: Only small alkali samples are approved for contact tests. Send the next batch to the Sunken Root Observatory for comparison under deep water pressure.
text.sdbf.book_page.4: Collect only resin that seeps naturally from the old tree. Do not cut the main roots. Keep the original viscosity of every MR-A sample.
text.sdbf.book_page.5: Crystallization differs between roots and high branches. The old landing served the supply route. Look for a maintenance hatch below its storage room.
text.sdbf.book_page.6: MR-P deep water group. Sealed observation tanks compare Menril resin under seabed pressure and normal pressure. Keep the sampling pipes isolated.
text.sdbf.book_page.7: Do not open both hatches together. Close the upper hatch and drain the airlock with a bucket before opening the lower hatch.
text.sdbf.book_page.8: Log each mysterious alkali crystal separately. Small powder samples are for controlled contact tests only. The archive stores the latest results.
text.sdbf.book_page.9: MR-H root group. The old roots surround three levels of galleries. Iron plates isolate the Menril resin test rooms.
text.sdbf.book_page.10: Side galleries reconnect at several junctions. Follow the numbered stair landings to return to the entrance pavilion.
text.sdbf.book_page.11: Mysterious alkali crystals remain exceptionally rare. Use one specimen at a time. Untreated resin still attracts hostile creatures.
commands.sdbf.tree_realm.stump_missing: No sunken stump found within the search radius. Try a larger radius or another ocean area.
commands.sdbf.tree_realm.stump_found: Nearest sunken stump in the Tree Realm: %s, about %s blocks away horizontally (current generation rules).
